title: InitiatorState: empty ZeroizeOnDrop does not generate Drop
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/initiator.rs
Line: 124
Category: memory-safety

## Description
Empty ZeroizeOnDrop impl does not generate Drop - PRK secrets (prk_2e, prk_3e2m, prk_4e3m) and transcript hashes persist in memory after InitiatorState is dropped. ZeroizeOnDrop is just a marker trait; actual zeroization requires #[derive(ZeroizeOnDrop)] or manual Drop impl calling zeroize().

## Fix
Replace `impl ZeroizeOnDrop for InitiatorState {}` with `impl Drop for InitiatorState { fn drop(&mut self) { self.zeroize(); } }` or use #[derive(ZeroizeOnDrop)] if deriving Zeroize
